MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.label: vanilla
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.description: Like the base game: the screen width is shared equally. No scrolling and no drawer.

MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.label: collapse
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.description: Buttons marked "Drawer" move into the More drawer; the rest share the bar.

MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.label: scroll
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.description: Buttons keep their width; scroll the bar with the mouse wheel or the arrows. The drawer is not used.

MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.label: collapse + scroll
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.description: The drawer works as in Collapse; the remaining buttons scroll.
